meta.portco: Commonwealth Electrical Technologies / Horton Electrical Services (CT) - home sales in the CET-served CT and RI counties, per user request
meta.description: Residential (home) sales in all 8 Connecticut counties and Providence County RI (Cranston).
method: CT OPM Socrata https://data.ct.gov/resource/5mzw-sjtu.json $where=daterecorded>='2025-06-01' AND propertytype='Residential' AND saleamount>=2000 (OPM newest vintage ends at 2025-09-30); county via CT towns crosswalk https://data.ct.gov/resource/5hqs-h5c3.json.

CT CAMA https://services3.arcgis.com/3FL1kr7L4LvwA2Kb/arcgis/rest/services/Connecticut_CAMA_and_Parcel_Layer/FeatureServer/0 where Sale_Date in Oct 2025-2026 AND State_Use LIKE '1%' (13x residential land excluded) AND Sale_Price >= 2000, returnCentroid, outSR 4326.
Cranston RI https://arcgisserver.cranstonri.org/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels/FeatureServer/0 where RecordDate >= 2025-09-01 AND SalesPrice >= 2000, residential state/land-use codes only.
caveats: CT OPM rows have no buyer, year built, sqft or beds. OPM arms_length = no Non Use Code. OPM rows without a published point are placed at the town median (geo_precision "town").
CT CAMA holds each parcel's LAST sale only, and town extracts end between ~2026-01 and 2026-06; recent months are incomplete.
Rhode Island coverage is Cranston only (no statewide RI sales source is public; other towns are token-protected or lack sale fields).
CT counties are the 8 legacy counties (planning regions replaced them for Census purposes in 2022).
